items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: They had a fellow, they called Buddy Bodley. He would go up in the balloons.

ctx.x: Well, I tell you, they had a dance hall, and the dance was start at four o'clock in the evening, on Sunday evenings, in the yard. They danced in the yard. And they had a fellow, they called Buddy Bodley. He would go up in the balloons. And that's the largest place that place was packed.
